**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Make the unmerged PR object an explicit preparation prerequisite**

On a checkout without the closed, unmerged PR #286 head object, the documented reproduction procedure stops here before creating any trials. I reproduced this in the supplied checkout: `prepare.py` raises `ValueError: preparation command failed: git` when checking `16033d45…:ci/impact.py`. The `git show -h` usage requires an `<object>`; saving the planner bytes in the snapshot does not make that Git object available locally. Repository-wide searches found no prerequisite that fetches this PR ref. Document and verify an explicit way to obtain the pinned object, or make offline preparation use the already validated snapshot without requiring unreachable PR history.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
